subject: PO acknowledgement SLA and MSA redline coordination for portal onboarding
messages:
From: Lena Brooks <lena.brooks@medicasys.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: procurement_ops@medicasys.com
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Portal onboarding — PO acknowledgement window & MSA redline questions

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the kickoff yesterday. A couple of items came up as we reviewed the onboarding checklist:

- PO acknowledgement SLA: our procurement team expects a 48-hour acknowledgement window for EDI-enabled vendors. Can Redwood support an automated PO-ack back to Ariba/Coupa within 48 hours?
- Failure behavior: if EDI fails or the portal cannot accept the PO, what is your retry/backstop? We need to document the fallback and any manual reconciliation process.
- MSA redlines: attached our onboarding guide. We asked our legal to highlight a few clauses (limitation of liability, data processing scope). Do you have a redline to share?

Can we get a short note that we can include in our internal handoff (ops + legal)? We’re aiming to get the vendor registration completed this week.

Thanks,
Lena Brooks
Senior Procurement Manager
MedicaSys Health

Attachments: MedicaSys_Onboarding_Guide_20270518.pdf (PDF, 320KB)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Lena Brooks <lena.brooks@medicasys.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, procurement_ops@medicasys.com
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Portal onboarding — PO acknowledgement window & MSA redline questions

Hi Lena —

Appreciate the clear list. Quick answers up front, then next steps below:

- PO ack SLA: Redwood supports automated PO acknowledgements. We typically configure a 24-hour ack by default; 48 hours is acceptable and we can set that as the committed window for this integration.
- Failure / fallback: our gateway retries incoming EDI deliveries for up to 72 hours with exponential backoff; if still failing, we generate an exceptions ticket and notify both parties (ops@redwood.com and the customer procurement_ops). Manual reconciliation is routed through our Activation team.
- Redlines: attaching our preliminary MSA redline (Redwood_MSA_v3_redlines.pdf) and the draft order form. Kim from Legal is looped in to confirm on the liability/DPA scope.

Proposed next steps:
1) Kimberly to confirm any material legal objections to your highlighted clauses by EOD tomorrow.
2) Ops (Marissa) to confirm the SFTP/EDI handoff and PO-ack configuration by Friday.
3) If all good, we’ll circulate an updated MSA + order form and push to DocuSign early next week.

I’ll schedule a 30-min sync if you prefer to walk through the redline.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_MSA_v3_redlines.pdf (PDF, redline), Order_Form_Draft_20270518.docx (Word)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, lena.brooks@medicasys.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Portal onboarding — PO acknowledgement window & MSA redline questions

Hi all,

Reviewed the redline Jonas shared. High-level notes:

- Limitation of liability: We can accept a liability cap tied to the fees under the applicable order form (12 months total fees) but cannot agree to uncapped consequential damages. Suggested clause language in the attached PDF (see "Limitation_Suggested").
- DPA/data processing: The MSA references our standard DPA; scope needs to explicitly exclude non-custodial telemetry we use for runtime optimization unless MedicaSys needs telemetry retention beyond troubleshooting. Please confirm whether your security team requires telemetry logs retained beyond 90 days.
- PO acceptance: I agree to the 48-hour ack for registration purposes. For the MSA, we should add a sentence describing the automatic retry window and ticket escalation path (ops contact + SLA to acknowledge exceptions).

If MedicaSys can confirm the telemetry retention and accept the liability cap approach, we’ll prepare a clean MSA with tracked acceptance items. If you prefer different cap math, provide your target and we’ll circulate.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Attachment references: Redwood_MSA_v3_redlines.pdf (section notes)
From: Lena Brooks <lena.brooks@medicasys.com>

Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 12:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Portal onboarding — PO acknowledgement window & MSA redline questions

Kim / Jonas —

Thanks for the fast turnaround. A few clarifications (forwarding our procurement note inline):

> From: Procurement Ops <procurement_ops@medicasys.com>
> PO ack SLA: 48 hours required. If vendor cannot deliver EDI ack within 48 hours, procurement will flag and start manual PO acceptance.

We can accept the liability cap tied to 12 months of fees. Regarding telemetry — our security team does not require drift-level runtime telemetry beyond 30 days; their ask is for audit-level logs (who pulled what) for 1 year. Will Redwood be able to provide audit log export for 12 months?

Also, on the retry/fallback language: can you include a sentence that when EDI fails after retries, Redwood will create an exception ticket and notify both parties within 1 business hour and provide a reconciliation report within 3 business days? We need those SLAs documented in the order form appendix.

If you can confirm those points, we’ll queue legal to accept and expedite signature.

Lena Brooks
Senior Procurement Manager
MedicaSys Health

Lena —

Confirming acceptance and next steps:

- Liability cap: Redwood will accept a liability cap equal to 12 months of fees as reflected in the attached final MSA.
- Telemetry/audit logs: Redwood can expose audit-level logs (access records, API calls related to PO ingestion and ack) for 12 months. Runtime telemetry beyond 90 days will not be retained unless separately requested.
- Exception SLA: Ops will create an exception ticket if EDI fails after retries; notifications to both parties within 1 business hour and a reconciliation report within 3 business days will be added to the order form appendix.

Next steps / mutual action plan:
- Today: Redwood to update MSA + order form with the agreed bullets and circulate for legal signoff (DocuSign link included).
- Tue 2027-05-25: Activation team to provision SFTP/EDI endpoint and share credentials with MedicaSys ops.
- Wed 2027-05-26: Test ingestion + PO ack flow; target 24-hour turnaround in sandbox, 48-hour committed window in production.

Attachments and links: Redwood_Final_MSA_20270521.pdf (clean MSA for signature), https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/REDW-7890, DocuSign: https://docusign.com/placeholder/REDW-7890

If that aligns, I’ll push the DocuSign envelope and ticket the activation tasks.

Thanks all —
